from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, http.client, json, os, queue, re, signal, subprocess, threading
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('compiler',type=Path);p.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args()
nex=a.compiler.resolve();out=a.output.resolve();out.mkdir()
project=out/'project';project.mkdir()
(project/'nex.json').write_text('{"schema":"nex.project/1","language":"0.30","entry":"main.nex"}')
source='''module cli_http;import "std/http.nex" as http;
server fn handle(req:http::Request)->http::Response!{state}{let c:cell<str>=cell_new(req.body);let alias:cell<str>=c;cell_write(alias,cell_read(c)+"!");return http::text_response(200,cell_read(c));}fn main()->unit{}'''
(project/'main.nex').write_text(source)
auth=out/'auth.json';auth.write_text(json.dumps({'schema':'nex.auth/1','tokens':[{'user':'alice','sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'fixture-alice').hexdigest()}]}))
report={'schema':'nex.references030-cli-http/1','ok':False,'compiler_sha256':hashlib.sha256(nex.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),'images':[],'requests':[]}
for profile in ['debug','release']:
    r=subprocess.run([str(nex),'build','--target','server','--profile',profile,'--json'],cwd=project,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=240)
    (out/(profile+'-build.stdout')).write_text(r.stdout);(out/(profile+'-build.stderr')).write_text(r.stderr)
    assert r.returncode==0,(r.stdout,r.stderr)
    built=json.loads(r.stdout);image=Path(built['executable']);metadata=json.loads(Path(built['metadata']).read_text())
    assert metadata['reference_context']['schema']=='nex.reference-http-context/1'
    err=(out/(profile+'-server.stderr')).open('w');server=subprocess.Popen([str(image),'--auth',str(auth),'--database',str(out/(profile+'.sqlite')),'--port','0'],cwd=out,env={**os.environ,'NEX_RESOURCE_DIR':str(out/'missing')},stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=err,text=True)
    first=''
    try:
        q=queue.Queue();thread=threading.Thread(target=lambda:q.put(server.stdout.readline()),daemon=True);thread.start();first=q.get(timeout=20)
        match=re.fullmatch(r'NEX server http://127\.0\.0\.1:([0-9]+)\n',first);assert match,first;port=int(match[1])
        for text in ['', 'abc', 'λ\0🙂', 'another']:
            c=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',port,timeout=10)
            try:
                c.request('POST','/api/check',body=text.encode(),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer fixture-alice'})
                response=c.getresponse();body=response.read().decode();assert response.status==200 and body==text+'!',(response.status,body)
                report['requests'].append({'profile':profile,'input':text,'status':response.status,'body':body})
            finally:c.close()
    finally:
        if server.poll() is None:server.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
        rest,_=server.communicate(timeout=20);err.close();(out/(profile+'-server.stdout')).write_text(first+rest)
        errors=(out/(profile+'-server.stderr')).read_text();assert server.returncode==0 and not errors,(server.returncode,errors)
    report['images'].append({'profile':profile,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(image.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'context':metadata['reference_context'],'exit':server.returncode,'no_live_values':True})
report['ok']=True;(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'requests':len(report['requests'])}))
